scoring_justification: Full recomputation of the LA/TA ratio would require re-running the heavy phonon emission simulation, which is not feasible in the verifier sandbox. The verifier compares the agent's reported ratios against the paper's gold values with appropriate tolerances and checks the expected physical trend.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold LA/TA ratios for five structures from the paper's Table 1 (our theory row).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1, 'our theory' row: values 1.59, 0.92, 0.27, 0.16, 0.10 for 5.1nm, 6.8nm, 12nm, 15nm QWs and HET respectively.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported theoretical predictions; the checker verifies the agent's reproduction against them.

outputs.description: LA/TA phonon emission ratio for five device structures (QW 5.1, 6.8, 12, 15 nm and heterostructure) computed by the theoretical model. The hidden checker compares each ratio against the paper-reported gold value with an appropriate tolerance and verifies the monotonic trend of decreasing ratio with increasing well width.

output_contract.notes: Only the LA/TA ratio is scored; the checker will use a hidden tolerance (e.g., relative 25% or absolute 0.1, whichever is larger) and a structural check that the ratio decreases monotonically with well width. The heterostructure row may have a NaN well_width_nm.

steps.description: Compare each structure's LA/TA ratio against hidden gold values and check monotonic decreasing trend for quantum wells.
steps.tolerance_definition: Per structure: acceptable if absolute error <= 0.1 OR relative error <= 0.25 (whichever gives larger allowed error).
